content: मञ्चः [मञ्च्-घञ्] .²1 A couch, bedstead, sofa, bed. .²2 A raised seat, {%dais%}, a platform resting on columns, a seat of honour or state, throne; मञ्चाः क्रियन्तां विविधा मल्लरङ्गपरिश्रिताः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 36. 25</ls>; स तत्र मञ्चेषु मनोज्ञवेषान् <ls>R. 6. 1</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 10</ls>. .²3 An elevated shed in a field (for a watchman). .²4 A pulpit. .²5 A stage, platform.
